title: building something in dream
content: I've been finding out that a lot of my dreams are connected to mall world//the bathroom maze. there's this other dream I have often, and I'm wondering if it's connected, if anyone else has the dream. so in the dream I'm building something. I'm on a platform, as well as other workers too, like in a video game. the platforms are black and it isn't all fun like this picture, but this is just what I mean by platforms. I never know what I'm building, but this is a reoccurring dream.
